kickerPill.purpose: Tracked-caps band above a heavier header.

shadows.name: sticker-shadow
shadows.purpose: Primary tier — cards, panels, modals. The paper-cutout lift, zero blur.

shadows.name: small-shadow
shadows.purpose: Lighter companion — chips, buttons, list rows. Zero blur.

components.name: Sticker
components.description: The signature primitive — nearly every surface. Ink-outlined pastel paper, hand-drawn tilt, hard zero-blur shadow.
components.css: .ds-sticker { background: #fffaf0; border: 2px solid #2a1f15; border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; transform: rotate(-0.6deg); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 0 #2a1f15; font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; color: #2a1f15; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gradient CTA wrapped in the signature ink outline + small hard shadow, so it reads as a hand-drawn button not a flat pill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(#F0B8C8, #E8A7B9); color: #2a1f15; border: 2px solid #2a1f15; border-radius: 22px; height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 0 #2a1f15; transition: transform 0.12s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 0 #2a1f15; }

components.name: Locked Button
components.description: The 'asleep' button — a disabled control that keeps its full chrome. Muted fill, muted text, NO opacity crush.
components.css: .ds-btn-locked { background: #f4efe7; color: #9a9a9a; border: 2px solid #2a1f15; border-radius: 22px; height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Kicker
components.description: The rust hand-drawn line above a section title. The one accent, never a fill.
components.css: .ds-kicker { font-family: 'Patrick Hand', cursive; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.4px; color: #c25a3f; }

narrative.overview: Tickle the Pig looks like a storybook someone who cares assembled by hand: ink-outlined stickers pinned with tape onto warm cream paper, each card tilted a degree or two off-square, throwing a hard offset shadow as if lit by a single desk lamp. The whimsy IS the design, not decoration bolted onto a neutral shell. This system explicitly rejects the SaaS-dashboard playbook; slop here is governance erosion — the intentional tokens silently bypassed — not a generic look. The system shows feelings rather than stating them: a pig's mood is its sprite, a streak is a garden that grows, and the world responds now.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-outlined paper stickers on warm cream, every card tilted and hard-shadowed
One palette (WHIMSY): muted storybook pastels, rust accent, dark bark for storyteller callouts
Four fonts, each with a job: Caprasimo, Nunito, Fredoka, PatrickHand
Two hard shadow tiers, zero blur
Springy, hand-wound motion; feelings shown as sprites and growth, never numbers
No emoji, ever — hand-drawn Glyph or SVG Icon only

rules.name: The One Palette Rule
rules.body: All color comes from WHIMSY. If a value isn't a token, use an existing token or add one — never inline a raw hex past the token layer.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Rust (#c25a3f) is a kicker color, never a fill. The moment it becomes a button or card background, it stops being the accent.

rules.name: The Compose-From-Roles Rule
rules.body: Text is built from TYPE role styles, not raw sizes, with color applied per use. A bare fontSize in new code is a smell.

rules.name: The Feelings-Aren't-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Numbers are allowed for progression only. Anything emotional is shown, never numbered: mood is a sprite, a streak is a garden.

rules.name: The Two-Tiers-No-Blur Rule
rules.body: Sticker contexts use only STICKER_SHADOW (4,4) or SHADOW_SM (2,2), both zero-blur, ink-colored. A blurred shadow belongs to a different app.

dos: Do reach for tokens: WHIMSY, FONTS, TYPE, RADII, SPACE, STICKER_SHADOW/SHADOW_SM. constants/theme.ts is the single source of truth.
Do put every surface on a Sticker — 2px ink border, hand-drawn tilt, a hard zero-blur shadow.
Do compose text from TYPE roles with a color applied per use; keep the 18px canonical page padding.
Do show feelings as sprites and growth — mood is Rosie's sprite, a streak is the garden.
Do make the world respond now — animate the claim on tap, vanish the cleansed curse immediately.
Do keep every screen cream/paper and crown every stack screen with PageHeader.
donts: Don't treat this like a SaaS dashboard — a borderless, perfectly-aligned, soft-shadow card is slop here.
Don't inline a raw hex, font size, radius, or pad past the token layer. That governance erosion is the slop.
Don't add a third shadow tier or a blurred shadow in a sticker context.
Don't use a meter, number, or label for anything emotional.
Don't ever put an emoji character in a render — use Glyph or Icon.
Don't wrap a screen in black (#1A1A1A) — it breaks the warm cream continuity.
Don't dissolve a disabled control's outline under an opacity crush — mute the fill, keep the shape.
